My recollection is that each of you is somewhat of a cricket fan, as I am.
I just happen to have 4 great seats for Opening Day at Tasman Ridge Oval, for
which I very much need company to help me enjoy. I would love it if each
of you could join me. The game starts at 4:05 pm, so it might require
leaving the office a little early. But of course we would be discussing
serious business the entire time so that it would be fully justifiable to
anyone interested. I will bring my legal pad to take notes.

Let me know. Hope you can come.

cgt
